description: This file is a Java Spring MVC controller named EmployeeSearchController, responsible for handling employee's client search operations such as default listing, city-based search, status-based search, name search, and functionalities for printing and exporting client lists.

classes.name: EmployeeSearchController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller managing employee client search functionalities such as listing clients, filtering by city/status/name, printing, and exporting client data.

methods.name: addAttributes
methods.description: Adds common attributes to the model, such as status list for client filtering.

methods.name: defaultSearch
methods.description: Performs a default client search listing clients managed by the authenticated user.

methods.name: citySearch
methods.description: Retrieves clients based on the city of the authenticated user's office.

methods.name: statusSearch
methods.description: Filters clients based on the status provided, within the city of the user's office.

methods.name: nameSearch
methods.description: Filters clients by name containing a specified string, within the user's city.

methods.name: printSearch
methods.description: Generates a PDF with the list of clients currently in the clientList.

methods.name: exportSearch
methods.description: Exports the current clientList to a CSV file.
